shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'package-lock.json' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' -g 'specs/**' -g 'src/orchestration/tools/**' | sort && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,180p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by:|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -120 && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n '\"ajv\"|\"version\"' package-lock.json | head -20 && rg --files scripts/spec-links scripts | sort | rg 'reanchor|spec-link'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+#[0-9]+|spec-anchor|VALIDATED_BY\" src scripts eslint.config.mjs | head -120 && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/index.ts && sed -n '1,160p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,120p' jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,40p' && git diff --check && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --cached --check && git commit -m "feat(tools): reject invalid static schemas"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
